text:
sara: Quick check — we're doing a canary for the client-side gating change this week. plan is header-first + version fallback. pinging @alex @mike for guardrails.

alex: SG. want to make sure older clients (<=0.9.x) don't get accidentally opted-in. what's the exact header format?

mike: header will be `X-Redwood-Feature` with a CSV of flags, and we verify a signed token for toggles that can bypass server rules. default behavior: server ignores unknown header entries unless the client version >= min_allowed.

jin: can we avoid signing for the initial canary? signing adds infra work. maybe use a trusted-internal header for employees and a server-side 10% rollout for public.

alex: +1 to internal header for devs. but we need a guardrail to prevent header spoofing for prod traffic. simplest: only accept `X-Redwood-Beta` from IPs in our staging CIDR or from tokens issued to orgs flagged as internal.

ara: QA note — we need a compatibility matrix: Android/iOS/JS SDKs and versions, plus behavior when header present but version older. I'll write tests but need the exact rules.

mike: rules proposal (short):
- If `X-Redwood-Feature` present AND `X-Redwood-Client-Version` >= 1.2.0 => honor header flags.
- If header present AND client-version < 1.2.0 => ignore header, log a WARN metric.
- Internal-only header `X-Redwood-Beta: internal=true` accepted only from internal tokens/IPs.
- Server-side 10% rollout for public audience (no header) controlled by rollout-service.

sara: paste for code snippet so QA can use it in tests:
```
# example request that should enable `new_ui_flag` for supported clients
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  X-Redwood-Feature: new_ui_flag=on
  X-Redwood-Client-Version: 1.2.3
  Authorization: Bearer <sdk-token>
```

jin: for the logging path, let's emit metric `sdk_header_ignored` with tags `client_version` and `flag_name`. that'll help detect stranded users.

qa: I'll add tests: matrix rows for versions [0.8.1, 1.1.9, 1.2.0, 1.3.0], platforms [js, android, ios]. expected: only 1.2.0+ honors header. failing case should produce WARN and a supportable telemetry event.

alex: rollout steps idea:
1) internal dev team only via `X-Redwood-Beta` for 24h. check errors and metrics.
2) server-side 10% public for 48h. monitor latency, error rate, `sdk_header_ignored`.
3) expand to 50% over 72h if no regressions.
4) enable header-for-all 7d after 50% stable.

mike: rollback plan: flip server-side rollout to 0% and add a hotfix that forces header ignored logic if we see >0.5% error bump. deploy-bot will handle the flip.

deploy-bot: NOTE: automated canary windows are configured. to trigger internal header release use: `/canary release internal-header --duration 24h --owners @release-eng`

ara: docs required: SDK CHANGELOG lines, server-side KMS signing docs (if we add signing later), and a short support playbook for customers hitting header mismatches.

sara: action items
- @mike: add header acceptance code + metric emit (due EOD tmrw)
- @jin: firewall rule for internal header acceptance (due this week)
- @qa: add test matrix and run nightly canary tests (start today)
- @alex: draft support playbook and short FAQ (due Fri)

mike: I'll open PR and ping the thread when ready. thanks all :thumbsup:

sara: thanks — will check back after PR. if anyone sees weird traffic in the next 48h, drop it here and tag @sara.

qa: noted, running smoke now.
